//: This project was created when Kadi was four static HTML files, so its
dashboard settings served a static output directory and never used the
build output. After the Next.js migration that left / returning 404 while
/invite.html and /scanner.html kept working -- those are real files under
public/, which was being served flat while .next was discarded.
Fixed in the dashboard (Framework Preset -> Next.js, Output Directory
override cleared). Declaring the framework here as well keeps the intent
in the repo, so a project re-create or a preview branch cannot silently
Deliberately no outputDirectory: Vercel's Next.js builder manages its own
output, and pinning it here fights the builder rather than helping it.
